name: higgsfield-motion-studio-pro
label: Higgsfield Motion Studio Pro
description: AI-powered motion transfer studio - Transform static images into dynamic videos
longDescription: A professional AI-powered motion transfer studio built with React and TypeScript. Upload any image and a reference video, and the app uses Kling AI to apply the motion to your image, creating stunning dynamic videos. Features complete authentication, generation history, cloud storage, and advanced controls for motion strength, duration, quality, and aspect ratio.
author: Rax.diy Team
features: AI motion transfer using Kling AI API
Complete authentication with Email, Google, and GitHub OAuth
Generation history with cloud storage via Supabase
Advanced motion controls (strength, duration, quality, aspect ratio)
User profiles with per-user API key support
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
